content: Jesús, dule-milibake (4,000) masgi oguchad
Ibagwengine, dule-bukidar gannar Jesús-walik ambikunonimarbalid. Dulemar masgunned satesoggu, Jesús na e-sapinganse gochad, ega sogded:
—An wile we-dulemar-daked, ar ibapaagus anmarba garmakdimalad, emide, masgunned satemalad.
Mas-guchasuli an e-negse barmidele, igarba ukudba negoedmaloed, ar ade, bukidar dikasur danimalad.
E-sapingan, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Ar wegine dulemar mamaisulid. ¿Bia anmar dule-bukidaradga mas unniguar amiosunna?
Jesús na e-sapinganse egisded: —¿Bemar gwabigwa madu nikasunna? E-sapingan, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Anmar gwagugle (7) madu nika.

Geb Jesús dulemar napagi oambikued imaksad. E-argangi madu-gwagugled-susgua, Bab-Dummadga doggus-nuedye sogsad. Geb Jesús madu-bisge-bisge-imasgu, e-sapinganga madu uksad, adi, dulemarga mimiegar. Deyobi e-sapingan imaksad.
Deginbali, ua-burwigana wis-ichesaar nikamarbalid. Jesús Bab-Dummadga doggus-nuedye sogsabalid, geb e-sapinganga sogsad, dulemarga mimimarye.
Dulemar bela-nue-immeles mas guchamalad. Geb sorbali, Jesús-sapingan garba-gwagugle (7) mas-obichad wesmalad.
Bela-dule-milibakesaar (4,000) mas guchamalad. Geb Jesús e-neg-e-negse dulemar-barmisad.
A-sorbali, Jesús na e-sapinganmala urgi nakwisgu, Dalmanuta-yalaganba nadegusmalad.
Ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid dakbimalad
Fariseoʼmar, Jesúsʼse nonimalad, geb Jesúsʼbo abin-abin imakarmalad. Yamo Jesús-wilubdakega, nibneggined-ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid emarga oyoye ese egichiarmalad.

Jesús ulubgi ise-nue-bunnoar imaksad, geb sogded: “¿Ibiga we-dulemar-emmisgwamalad ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid imakbi an-abege? Napira an bemarga soged, bemar anse-ibmar-egisnaid, an bemarga oyogosulid.”
Geb degine, Jesús Fariseoʼmar-idu naded. Geb gannar urgi nakwisgu, mata-abin-obakar naded.
Fariseoʼmar-e-igar-odurdaked
Jesús-sapingan madu-seded ies nadmalad. Unnila madu-gwagwen uryagi semamaid.
Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: —Fariseoʼmar-madubur-inagi, degi, Herodes-madubur-inagi, nue salakarmar.
E-sapingan na muchub-muchub sognanai guarmalad: “Ar anmar madu satedbali, wede weyob soged.”
Jesús na e-sapingan degi-soge-itosgu, ega sogded: —¿Ibiga bemar madu surye sogmala? ¿Amba bemar aku dakmala, degi, nue aku itomarbali? ¿Amba be gwage dutusurmala?
Bemar ibya nikanad, degite ¿amba be aku dakmarde? Bemar uaya nikamarbalid, degite ¿amba bemar aku itomarbarde? ¿Bemar insasursi?
An dule-miliataledga (5,000) madu-gwaataled-mimisgu, ¿bemar garba-gwabigwa madu-obichad wesagusmala? E-sapingan, abin-sogdemalad: —Garba gwaambe-gakabo (12) anmar wesmalad.
Jesús sogdebalid: —Dule-milibaked-abargi (4,000) an madu-gwagugled-mimisbargu (7), ¿Bemar garba-gwabigwa wesagusmarbali? E-sapingan, abin-sogdemalad: —Garba gwagugle (7) anmar wesmalad.
Geb Jesús na e-sapinganga sogdebalid: —Degite ¿Ibiga bemar amba aku-itosunna?
Jesús, Betsaidaʼgi dule-aku-ataked nudaksad
Betsaida-neggweburse-nonimargu, dulemar dule-wargwen aku-ataked Jesúsʼse senonimalad. Dulemar, Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusmalad, dule-ebuye.
Jesús dule-aku-ataked argangi-gasgu, neggweburgi ega banguded. Geb Jesús dule-aku-ataked-ibyagi-wiaksagu, degi, e-argan egi mesisgu, ese egichided: —¿Emigindi, sunna mag be atake?
Dule-aku-ataked, atakdegu sogded: —Ar dulemar sapimaryob an daked, degi-inigwele, nanamar an daked.
Geb Jesús na e-argan gannar dule-aku-ataked-e-ibyagi mesisad, geb dule nugusad, magar atakded, degi, nue-swilidik atakdesunnad.
Jesús dule-nugusad e-negse barmisad, ega sogsad: —Mer be neggweburse doggwelo, degi, mer dulemarga be we-ibmar sogbalo.
Pedro, Jesúsʼga sogsad, be Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadye
Jesús na e-sapinganmala, Cesarea-De-Filipos-neggwebur-burwigana-bukwadse nade gusmalad. Igarba-nadapidgi, Jesús na e-sapinganse egichialid: —Dulemar, ¿doaye an-annik sogmala?
E-sapingan, abin-sogdemalad: —Gwenna-gwenna Diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼye benik sogmalad. Baigandi, Elíasʼye benik sogmalad. Bamaladdi, be Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-wargwenadye benik sogmalad.

Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: —Bemardina, ¿doaye be an-annik sogmarmosunna? Pedro, Jesús-abin sogded: —Be, Cristo. (Griego-gayaba we-sogleged, Bab-Dummad epenne dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye).
Jesús na e-sapinganga igar uksad, melle dulemar-baiganga bipisaar sogoye, ede Cristoʼye, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye.
Jesús na e-burgoedgi sunmaksad

Jesús na e-sapingan-odurdakde, sogded: —Ani Dule-Machi, nue wilegergebed. Judíoʼmar-girmar-dummagan, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar, gwen an-abingaosulid. An-oburgwemaloed, degi-inigwele, ibapaagi an gannar durgubaloed.
Jesús na e-sapinganga e-burgoedgi ise-bakarbud sunmaksad. Geb degine, Pedro Jesús-bachikii sesad. Jesús weyob-sogsad-ulale, Pedro Jesúsʼga binnasur ibmar sogded.
Jesúsʼdi biir-imaksagu, e-sapingan-dakdegu, Pedroʼga sabsur sogded: —Nia-saila-Satanás, be angi bangusunna. Be Bab-Dummad-binsaeyob binsasulid, unnila dulemar-sunnaa be binsaed.

Geb Jesús na e-sapinganse, degi, dulemar-baiganse-gochagua, ega sogded: —Ar dule-gwensak an-sapinga gubiele, na dukin san-iegergebed. Bato burgwenadapidgi-nakrus-semaiyob nanaergebed, geb a-dule anba dagodo.
Ar dule-wargwen, unnila na e-san-bendakbiedginbi binsaele, na e-san-burba ei yogguoed. Ar dule anba-naid-ular, degi, an-gayaburba-nued-ular, burgwenonikirdi, na e-san-burba yogguosulid.
”Dule bela napneg-naid egadga imakele, ¿ar ega ibi-nued-gue, na e-san-burbadi yogguer?
Igidibe, dule-gwensak na e-san-burba-ular, ¿ibi na uksar be insae? Ibmar sate, san-burba-ular uked.

Degisoggu, dule-gwensak, we-dulemar-galagwensulidamalad-abargi, degi, dule-isganamar-abargi, anba-naid-ular, degi, an-gayaburba-nuedgi, bingeguele, ani Dule-Machi, an-baliwiturmar-islidikidmalad-abargi, an-Bab-Dummad-gangued-yeerdakleged-nikadgi an danikir, an we-dulegi bingegumogoed.”
